threads.body: `_set_invocation_output()` currently hard-codes `OutputMessage(role="assistant", finish_reason="stop")`. With the new Workflow/Step instrumentation calling this helper, spans may record incorrect roles/finish reasons even when Agno results provide `role` / `finish_reason`. Consider updating `_set_invocation_output()` to read these fields from `result` when available (mirroring `_set_model_invocation_output()`).
